blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Astrobiologists think our best bet for finding life on other planets is to search for water.
exercises.ru: Астробиологи считают, что ___ верный способ найти жизнь на других планетах — искать на них воду.
exercises.why: «To get the superlative degree in Russian place the word "самый" before the adjective … "Самый" is declined like regular adjective.» — DLI, Lesson 83. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
